newsitem.title: UK: Geoff Corpe stays at MSAS as UK managing director.
newsitem.headline: Geoff Corpe stays at MSAS as UK managing director.

text.p: MSAS Cargo International UK managing director Geoff Corpe will remain with the international freight forwarding group contrary to an announcement in September that he would join British Airways Air Cargo.

"MSAS UK and BA Cargo, both, are in the middle of exciting and challenging programmes that promise considerable change for the future. And, I believe it is very important that I see through to completion a number of projects at MSAS UK in which I have had personal involvement." Corpe said in a statement.
MSAS has 5,500 employees in 30 countries and agents in a further 84 countries is part of the Ocean Group plc. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
